title: Chapter 499 - 499 Strolling Around; Meeting An Acquaintance!
content:
Chapter 499 - 499 Strolling Around; Meeting An Acquaintance!

Chapter 499 - 499 Strolling Around; Meeting an Acquaintance!

499 Strolling Around; Meeting an Acquaintance!

Liu Qianqian looked at Lin Fan in front of her and then at Xia Bing and Xia Xue, who were lying on the sofa with their faces flushed red…

Then, she thought of last night. She vaguely saw Lin Fan walk into Xia Bing and Xia Xue’s room.

Could it be… Did Lin Fan stay with Xia Bing and Xia Xue for an entire night?

Instantly, images unsuitable for children appeared in Liu Qianqian’s mind.

A blush appeared on her pretty face.

Then, Liu Qianqian ran back to her room without greeting Lin Fan.

Lin Fan looked at her back and shut his mouth. He muttered, “What’s going on?”

Of course, Lin Fan did not care too much.

He shrugged and returned to his presidential suite. After taking a refreshing shower, he slowly opened the door.

At this moment, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and Hao Zhiwu were standing in the corridor.

As usual, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Hao Zhiwu shouted, “Good morning, Professor Lin.”

Among them, Hao Zhiwu’s voice was the loudest and most excited.

After all, this was his first night abroad!

He even stayed in the presidential suite of the Shangri-La Hotel and experienced a luxury he had never experienced before.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue blushed and buried their small heads. They said softly, “Good morning, Professor Lin.”

Liu Qianqian’s voice was also very soft, and her face was still blushing.

However, her mentality was different from Xia Bing and Xia Xue. She was trying to hide her reaction.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan did not mind at all. He nodded and said, “Good morning. Let’s have breakfast together.”

The breakfast at Barney Shangri-La Hotel was also very sumptuous.

Exquisite pastries, M5 beef, natural corn, sweet potatoes, seafood noodles, ham, fragrant bread, and toast…

Everyone was very satisfied.

The Fields Medal ceremony would be held tomorrow.

Today was the day for everyone to hang out around Barney.

Lin Fan glanced at Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, and Jiang Chaoqun, who were walking out of the Shangri-La Hotel and looking around curiously.

They looked like children who had just learned how to walk. They were filled with curiosity about everything that was unfamiliar to them.

However, they were worried that Lin Fan would blame them.

Therefore, they could only suppress their curiosity and follow behind Lin Fan quietly.

Lin Fan smiled and said, “You guys don’t have to follow me around. Just go around. Of course, don’t get lost.”

Lin Fan had said that they could treat him as a peer when they were outside, and it was indeed a fact, but how could they really?

After all, Lin Fan was their teacher, a genius professor who was known throughout the world!

Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Hao Zhiwu, and the others all looked happy when they heard that. They replied, “Alright.”

Then, everyone walked into the distance.

Lin Fan shook his head and started to stroll around this unfamiliar city.

Barney was indeed an international metropolis.

Perhaps the city looked similar to Jiangbei.

However, when one was in Jiangbei, one only had the chance to see luxury brands such as LV, Gucci, Chanel, Cartier, Versace, and so on in some high-end shopping malls.

On Barney’s streets, these luxury brands could be seen everywhere.

Lin Fan looked at Barney’s unique buildings for a while and then walked on the winding sidewalk for a while. His gaze fell on the luxury stores.

He muttered, “I don’t have anything to do anyway. I’ll just buy some things. Consider it a souvenir for the students who came to Barney.”

As he spoke, he walked straight into the nearest shop.

…

Compared to Lin Fan, who was walking calmly, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Hao Zhiwu, and the others kept looking around, occasionally letting out gasps of praise.

“Wow! Look, that place is so beautiful!”

“Come, take a photo of me.”

“I want to take photos too!”

The few of them took photos as they walked.

Not long after, they saw a long row of luxury stores.

“LV, Gucci, Versace… A lot of luxury goods stores!

“Give me a close-up!”

…

“Ta Ta Ta!”

At this moment, a series of dull footsteps sounded not far away.

A slightly pungent smell drifted over.

“Liu Qianqian?!” A woman in high heels as thick as a thumb called out in a slightly ear-piercing voice. She was holding a middle-aged man’s arm.

When Liu Qianqian heard this, she slowly turned around and said with uncertainty,” You’re… Wan Fei?”

“Hehe, it’s me!” Wan Fei smiled. “I didn’t expect to meet you here! We haven’t seen each other for five or six years since we were separated into different classes in the first year of high school.”

“Yes, I am,” Liu Qianqian said happily.

Even though Liu Qianqian and Wan Fei were not on very good terms in high school, they were still classmates, after all.

It was very rare to meet a former classmate in a foreign country.

“Right, didn’t I hear that you went to Xia Ke University?” Wan Fei asked. “Why are you here in Barney?”

Liu Qianqian said, “I’m not studying at Jiangbei University. My professor is here to receive an award, so my classmates and I are here to play.”

Speaking of the professor, Liu Qianqian’s face revealed a complicated expression of admiration, yearning, helplessness, and so on.

Then, she introduced, “Right, these are my classmates—Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Hao Zhiwu.”

“Hello, we’re Liu Qianqian’s classmates.”

Wan Fei nodded casually. “So you’re all students of Jiangbei University. No wonder you look so knowledgeable.

“Especially your professor. He must be very impressive to be able to come to Barney to receive an award.”

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and Hao Zhiwu all nodded.

Obviously, they all agreed with this statement.

Lin Fan was indeed amazing!

“Oh right, why are you all standing on the road?” Wan Fei asked again. “Let’s go to the shops and buy some things.”

“When I was studying in the past, I always felt that things like Gucci and LV were all very expensive! Only now did I know that they aren’t expensive at all!

“For example, this Chanel bracelet that my husband just bought for me only cost 50,000 yuan, and this LV bag only cost 80,000 yuan… They’re very cheap!”

As she spoke, she deliberately waved the bracelet on her wrist and the bag on her shoulder.

Then, she continued, “Let’s go. Let’s go in and buy something. They’re all so cheap anyway.”

After saying that, her face revealed a hint of contempt that was difficult to detect.
